experiment: E3: the certified head inside the decode loop of Qwen3-0.6B, measured end to end
written: 2026-11-17, after E2 and the memory-tier run were read, before any E3 code ran
why: E2's 7% on an A10G was an estimate by substitution: the certified head was timed alone and swapped into the step on paper. E3 puts it in the loop and measures the step.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B at c1899de2, BF16, batch 1, greedy, the 24 prompts of E2, Hugging Face generate with cache_implementation = 'static' (E2's fastest working configuration)

variants.stock: the model as shipped: the BF16 output layer inside the forward pass, generate takes the argmax
variants.certified: the output layer replaced by an identity, so the forward pass returns the final hidden state; a logits processor runs the unified kernel (kernel/fused2.py, shift 0.5, graph-captured) on that state and hands generate a score vector whose argmax is the certified token. The 4-bit, INT8 and BF16 copies are all on the GPU.

settings_common_to_both: end-of-sequence stopping disabled so that exactly the requested number of tokens is generated, repetition penalty 1, no sampling
measured: milliseconds per new token: (time for 72 new tokens - time for 8) / 64, each prompt warmed up and then timed, minimum of two runs; order stock, certified, stock again, to see drift

checks.tokens: in a separate untimed pass the certified loop records every state and token: each token equals the argmax of the FP32 product of that state with the BF16 head
checks.sequences: the share of prompts whose 72-token continuation is identical between the two variants is reported; they can differ where the stock BF16 head breaks a tie differently from the FP32 reference

prediction_written_before_running.tokens: no certified token differs from the reference
prediction_written_before_running.a10g: the certified step is 0.93 to 0.97 of the stock step: E2 estimated 0.928, and the logits processor and its copies cost something
prediction_written_before_running.a100: between 0.99 and 1.03 of the stock step: nothing to gain there
prediction_written_before_running.drift: the two stock measurements agree within 2%
prediction_written_before_running.takeaway_if_wrong: If the A10G ratio is at or below 0.95, this is the first measured end-to-end gain and belongs in the paper as such. If it is above 0.99, the integration overhead eats the head's saving and E2's estimate was too optimistic.
